Boston Metropolitan Chess League (team signup) Register Online Now
DateTuesday, September 1, 2026
Event FormatTeam League. Each match consists of two games against the same opponent (one with each color) on at least four boards. Home teams have Black in Game 1 and White in Game 2.
Time ControlG/45 + 5
SectionsTwo divisions based on team strength: Championship & Reserve divisions
Entry Fee$50 per team. Teams may add players throughout the season, provided they are added to the roster at least two days before playing.
Prizes$1,000 Guaranteed Prize Fund. Team prizes will be awarded to the Regular Season and Playoff Champions in each division, along with individual board prizes for the top performers on Boards 1–4 in each division.
DescriptionSee full league description

**October 2026 – April 2027**
Regular season matches are played once per month from October through March, with playoffs in April. Teams select their home playing night during registration.

The Boston Metropolitan Chess League is one of the nation's oldest team chess competitions, bringing together clubs, schools, and groups from across Greater Boston for monthly team matches. The 2026–27 season features seven regular-season matches followed by divisional playoffs. Teams consist of at least four boards and play two games against each opponent—one with each color—making every match a true test of team depth. Teams may field additional players throughout the season, and clubs are welcome to enter multiple teams in different divisions. Whether you're representing a long-established chess club or organizing a new group of friends, the BMCL offers a fun, competitive, and flexible way to enjoy over-the-board team chess.

Two divisions based on team strength:
- Championship Division (approximately U2200 average strength)
- Reserve Division (approximately U1900 average strength)

Final division assignments may be adjusted to create balanced competition.

Early Autumn Six-Week Swiss Online
DateTuesday, September 1, 2026
Event Format6SS or Double Quad, 1 lichess game per Tuesday night
Time ControlG/60 + 10 sec
SectionsQuads & Small Swiss
Entry Fee$40, $25 for BCF members
Prizes$80-$40 Quad #1; $50-$40 all other Quads & Small Swiss
Round TimesTuesday at 6:30 PM unless two players agree to reschedule
DescriptionContact info: TD Nick Sterling. E-mail: td@boylstonchess.org. Text/cell: 781-733-0849.

If I do not have your e-mail and cell phone # already, please send those to me in case we have to contact each other.

If I do not have your lichess Username, please send that to me or include it in the comments in your Registration.

For Round 1, Pairings will be posted on Tuesday just after 6 PM on the Boylston CC website. The cutoff time for registration in time to play a Round is Tuesday at 6 PM. Any players who register subsequent to 6 PM will be skipped until the following week's Round. Each Round begins at 6:30 PM except for games whose start times were agreed in advance to be changed.

The tournament may be run as one large Swiss instead of Quads at the TD's discretion.

Players must join Zoom and Share their Screens or show their play areas in their camera views. The link will be sent to players by e-mail. Players with scores of at least +2, or in contention for a prize, may, at the TD's discretion, be required to provide at least two separate camera views on Zoom.

Players must be current Members of USCF.

Forfeit of a Round for any reason may result in forfeit of any prize $$$ that would otherwise have been won, at the TD's discretion.

Rating with USCF will be delayed by 72 hours after the completion of the tournament to give lichess time to ensure Fair Play was observed in all games.

BCF Annual Meeting
DateWednesday, October 14, 2026
Round Times7:30pm
DescriptionOn Wednesday, October 14, the Boylston Chess Foundation will hold our Annual Membership Meeting.

On this important night, we will conduct our annual election of Officers and Board Members. The meeting will start at 7:30 PM, and the election will be held shortly thereafter.

Please come to this important event, and help determine the future of our non-profit organization.

The meeting will be held at 35 Kingston St in Boston. Parking is available on both sides of Kingston St, or in the nearby Post Office Square garage.


To be eligible to vote, you must be a member in good standing at the time of our Annual Meeting, and have been a member for a least one month at any time prior to the date of the meeting. Our membership vote is non-binding, and must be ratified by the current Board of Directors.

We hope that every member who is able to, attends our annual meeting on October 14. Together, we can continue to strengthen our foundation and give it a bright future!
